notes.title: New update for SoulQuest demo and we are at Gamescom!!
notes.content: [p]Hi! Everyone! It's been a while.[/p][p]SoulQuest development has been coming up pretty smoothly in the last months. I'm happy to say that more announcements will be coming shortly regarding SoulQuest release, but in the meantime, I made an update to the game's demo with some new stuff and tweaks to the movement and combat momentum.[/p][p][/p][p]Changes made:[/p][p]- Fixed Xbox Wireless controls not being recognized.[/p][p]- Changed the layout of the cave levels to reflect more of how they will be played out in the final release.[/p][p]- Added a new lighting system that can be turned on/off in the menus.[/p][p]- Added 2 new combat moves for Alys to buy in the Abanus store.[/p][p]- Added "Abanus Wardrobe" where players can submit codes to change their color palettes and pets' appearance.[/p][p]- Added a training mode accessible through Abanus Bed.[/p][p]- Added more friction to Alys' movement during combat.[/p][p]- WallJumping has been revamped.[/p][p]- Added pop-up tutorials.[/p][p]- Changed the splash screen art.[/p][p]- Corrected some misspelling errors.[/p][p][/p][p]Also, SoulQuest is currently present at Gamescom right now! [/p][p]You can find it in the Indie.io booth located in Hall 10.2, Booth F-011[/p][p][/p]

tags.bug: - Fixed Xbox Wireless controls not being recognized.

tags.feature: - Changed the layout of the cave levels to reflect more of how they will be played out in the final release.
- Added a new lighting system that can be turned on/off in the menus.
- Added 2 new combat moves for Alys to buy in the Abanus store.
- Added "Abanus Wardrobe" where players can submit codes to change their color palettes and pets' appearance.
- Added a training mode accessible through Abanus Bed.

tags.balance_change: - Added more friction to Alys' movement during combat.

notes.title: Kickstarter IS LIVE & UPDATE 0.1.7
notes.content:
[h1]I’m so excited to share that the Kickstarter for SoulQuest is NOW LIVE!! [/h1]

[h3]This will allow me to get enough funding to get an art team for the game as well as to leave my full-time job to focus exclusively in the development of SoulQuest to finally being able to release the game I always dreamed of![/h3]

[h2][b][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/freedomgamesgg/soul-quest]Press here to see the Kickstarter[/url][/b][/h2]

[h2]To celebrate this milestone I also released a new version of the demo (0.1.7) with the following changes: [/h2]

[list]
[*] New portraits for Alys and Abanus!
[*] Fixed a bug that gives you invulnerability if you jumped mid-dash
[*] Fixed a translation error if you changed languages in the pause menu
[*] Fixed an error that kept the death music if you restarted the game too quickly
[*] Added the option of changing sides when you canceled a dash with an attack
[*] Added the cancel an airdash with an attack
[/list]

Fixed an error that kept the death music if you restarted the game too quickly

notes.title: Announcements and Demo Update
notes.content:
A new update has come to SoulQuest to fix some errors and changes asked by the community. I also wanted to remind you all that SoulQuest has a Kickstarter follower page up and now we have opened a mailing list for everyone interested in receiving all the news about the Kickstarter.

The success of the Kickstarter will determine the scope of the final release with some of the stretch goals being full console porting and even a second playable character!!!

Kickstarter: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/freedomgamesgg/soul-quest

Mailing list: https://soulquestgame.substack.com/?r=16dlb8&utm_campaign=pub-share-checklist


Changes made in this version:
- Fixed some crashing errors in the Boss Room.
- Added a new audio slider to tune down the combat voice dialogs.
- You can pet the Dog!!! Barry has been added to Abanus's house!

tags.bug: - Fixed some crashing errors in the Boss Room.

tags.feature: - Added a new audio slider to tune down the combat voice dialogs.
- You can pet the Dog!!! Barry has been added to Abanus's house!

notes.title: Update 0.1.3 has arrived!!!
notes.content:
A new update has come to SoulQuest to fix some errors and rebalance asked by the community. Thank you guys so much for the support SoulQuest has been having this year.

Changes made:

- Added a zoom-out effect for platforming scenarios so players can get a better look at their surroundings.
- Increased the difficulty of the final boss.
- Increased air attacks style.
- Decreased "million stab" damage.
- Added a cooldown for aerial "million stab"
- Completing the current dialog now doesn't stop the voice audio.
- Corrected some misspelling errors.
- Added the function of running with the d-pad by double tapping a direction.
- Added the Join the Discord button on the main menu.

tags.balance_change: - Increased the difficulty of the final boss.
- Added a cooldown for aerial "million stab"

tags.bug: - Completing the current dialog now doesn't stop the voice audio.

tags.feature: - Added the function of running with the d-pad by double tapping a direction.
- Added the Join the Discord button on the main menu.

notes.title: The 1.1 update has arrived!!!
notes.content:
A new update has come to SoulQuest to fix some errors and to bring some changes asked by the community. I also wanted to thank everyone for the support SoulQuest has been having these months, the game's wishlist count almost tripled compared to the start of the year!

Changes made:

Flying enemies now bounce when thrown against walls.

Executioner and Fomorian stagger bars have been slightly increased.

Heavy attacks damage increased.

Bugs Fixed:

Fixed Million Stab controller input label.

Changes have been made in some rooms to avoid enemies getting stuck.

Fixed a crashing error when killing enemies with a "ToAir" attack.

Fixed a bug that caused entering a room with low health.

tags.balance_change: Executioner and Fomorian stagger bars have been slightly increased.

Changes have been made in some rooms to avoid enemies getting stuck.
Fixed a crashing error when killing enemies with a "ToAir" attack.
Fixed a bug that caused entering a room with low health.

notes.title: 0.1.0 Update!
notes.content:
The update 0.1.0 is officially out! Includes numerous changes such as:

- A Turkish translation.
- The possibility to perform "piercing cut" and "million stab" in the air.
- The finisher bar is now divided into two sections
- A new finisher is added that only requires half of the total finisher bar.
- Typos on the movelist inputs to perform some combos.
